x: The fifth stage was taken by Vernon Blowfield who is not yet fully fit, but maintained his position although yielding a little ground against strong opposition from the leader.
The 1,000 yards saw our real strength and here we had the first three home in Derrick Burfitt, Ches Walker and Vernon Blowfield, with Jimmy Wood, of the Poly, 4th.
Vernon Blowfield won the 2 miles run and A. Bergvalds won the discus and was second in the weight, but on the whole we did not do so well as expected.

Derrick Burfitt, the holder, Vernon Blowfield, who won in 1947, and Tom Carter, who scored wins in 1938, 1939 and then again when the race was resumed in 1945, were all absentees on this occasion, but even so, the field included two British Olympic representatives in Bill Lucas and Jack Braughton.

In 1949 the first two men home, Vernon Blowfield and Jack Brown went slightly off course and were effectively disqualified but Verne took the record down to 29.09 in 1950, and following the cancellation of the 1952 race through snow bound roads, Ray Tooby opened up the 28 minute era with 28.50 in 1953.
